name: 100W Monocrystalline Solar Panel
description: A compact solar panel that converts sunlight into electricity. Ideal for small solar power systems, lighting, battery charging, and other low-power applications.

name: 550W Solar Panel
description: A high-output solar panel designed for residential and commercial solar installations. It captures sunlight and produces electricity to help reduce dependence on grid power.

name: Solis Hybrid Inverter 5kW
description: Converts the DC electricity produced by solar panels into AC electricity for compatible household appliances. Depending on the model, it can also manage battery storage and grid power.

name: Solar Lithium Battery
description: Stores electricity generated by a solar system for later use, such as at night or during power interruptions. Designed for use with compatible inverters and battery systems.

name: MC4 Solar Connectors
description: Weather-resistant connectors used to connect compatible solar panel cables securely. Suitable for solar installations that require reliable electrical connections.

name: Solar Charge Controller
description: Regulates the electricity flowing from solar panels to a compatible battery, helping prevent overcharging and supporting efficient battery charging. Select the correct voltage and current rating for your system.

name: Solar LED Floodlight
description: An outdoor lighting solution powered by solar energy. Ideal for illuminating gardens, driveways, garages, and other outdoor spaces without requiring a standard wired power supply.

name: Solar Street Light
description: A solar-powered lighting system designed for streets, pathways, parking areas, and outdoor properties. It collects solar energy during the day and provides illumination at night.

name: Portable Solar Power Station
description: A portable battery power system for charging phones, laptops, and other compatible devices. It can be recharged using a compatible solar panel or another supported power source.

name: Solar Water Pump
description: A water-pumping solution designed to operate with a compatible solar power supply. Suitable for applications such as garden irrigation, water transfer, and agricultural use, depending on the pump's specifications.

name: Portable Generator
description: A portable power generator designed to provide backup electricity during power interruptions. Suitable for homes, small businesses, and outdoor use. Choose the appropriate capacity based on your power requirements.

name: Off-Grid Solar Inverter 3kW
description: Converts DC electricity from solar panels or a compatible battery into AC electricity for household appliances. Designed for off-grid solar systems, depending on the model's features and power capacity.
